title: Analysis of AI Diagnostic Performance Discrepancies Across Medical Imaging Modalities

contributions.purpose: 刻画医学影像 AI 的 '超声悖论' 现象
contributions.mechanism: 系统综述静态高对比(CT/MRI)与动态低对比(X 光/超声)模态文献
contributions.evaluation: 超声 AI AUROC 0.94(95%CI 0.88-1.00)高于 CT/MRI ~0.82;ChatGPT-4 视觉 MRI 准确率报 0%(均引自文献)
contributions.source_quote: the 'ultrasound paradox,' where AI achieves superior performance on comparatively lower-quality ultrasound images (AUROC 0.94) while struggling with high-resolution, complex modalities like MRI (reported accuracy as low as 0%).

contributions.mechanism: 将差距归于模态信息类型与 CNN 架构限制(感受野受限、难处理时序特征)的错配分析
contributions.evaluation: 论证性(非实验),引 Transformer/3D-CNN 等替代方案
contributions.source_quote: attributing them to a mismatch between the information type provided by a modality ... and the architectural constraints of dominant AI models like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).

contributions.mechanism: 多阶段 '混合诊断工作流':高敏感度 AI(X 光/超声)初筛 + 高特异度 AI(CT/MRI)确诊
contributions.evaluation: 仅概念提出,作者未做实验验证(评估为非数字/未测)
contributions.source_quote: we propose a multi-stage 'hybrid diagnostic workflow' that strategically combines high-sensitivity AI for initial screening ... with high-specificity AI for confirmation.

notes: 协议适配:本文为文献综述/立场论文,非实证——所有数字(AUROC 0.94、MRI 0%、27% 提速、12% 敏感度、50% 剂量下降)均引自既有文献,作者未开展任何实验;所提混合工作流未经检验(C3 evaluation 只能定性)。过度声称红旗:Conclusion 用 'Empirical Confirmation of Performance Gaps' 与 'Demonstrated Clinical Value' 等措辞,把他人研究结果表述为本文实证。据 abstract+conclusion 归纳 3 条贡献。
